title: Symphonia Prisma in 53-EDO — Adagio, Scherzo, Diesis & Passacaglia
description: An original ~4-minute stage-independent Western orchestral classical work in F Major (anchored around exact concert A4 = step 39 = 440.00 Hz). Showcases glass-pure 5-limit triads (4:5:6) and septimal harmonic ninths (4:5:6:7:9) from Bar 1, an upward syntonic comma lift (+1), a 4-voice woodwind/string fugato scherzo, a Beethovenian chromatic-mediant diesis summit (+1 -> +3) with triple downward comma cascade (+3 -> 0), and a Brahmsian passacaglia culminating in a Cathedral Pipe Organ apotheosis.
